subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check - ACME
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + pilot next steps

Thanks for the time today, Alex — really helpful call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

- Goal: Validate ACME search assistant accuracy + latency under realistic load; focus on customer-support use case.
- Success criteria: 90%+ helpful answers on our eval set, median latency < 300ms on 8k context.
- Pilot plan: 2-week pilot (production-like), sandbox dataset, shared eval set, usage telemetry.

Action items for ACME:
- Confirm expected token volumes (avg per request, daily peak, monthly projection).
- Confirm budget target for inference (target $/1M tokens) or range you have internally.
- Confirm any procurement requirements (PO, SOW, security addenda).

From our side we'll:
- Grant an initial pool of pilot credits to cover the first 1M tokens while we validate burn rate.
- Provide a suggested unit-econ estimate in the attached pilot-pricing-sheet.pdf and a quick usage export template (acme-pilot-usage.csv) for your telemetry.

If you can send the token-volume estimates and target $/1M tokens by EOD Wednesday (10/14), Ben and I will run a cost estimate and propose either extending credits or rebalancing the pilot.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
redwood.com
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + pilot next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. Couple quick answers: 

- Token volumes: for the initial POC we expect ~50k tokens/day (avg) rising to ~250k/day in peak tests. That maps to ~1.5M tokens in week 1 and ~7.5M tokens/month if we scale.
- Request size: median prompt+response ~600 tokens, peak ~2k tokens for long-context support threads.
- Budget: our finance lead asked for a target line item of <$2,000 per 1M tokens for the POC, but we can flex depending on performance.
- Procurement: Procurement wants an SOW and a short-term PO for pilot credits if we move forward; will loop them if we need legal/PO.

Attaching a small sample of expected request profiles in case it helps (not the full telemetry). We'll follow up with procurement contact if we proceed.

Best,
Alex

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call recap + pilot next steps

Alex / Marissa — quick calc based on Alex's volumes to show runway and suggested credits: 

Assumptions (example model): 1.5M tokens/week initial, 7.5M tokens/month scaled.
- If ACME targets $2,000 / 1M tokens then monthly cost at 7.5M ≈ $15k.
- If we cover the first 1M tokens with free credits, that's roughly a $2k subsidy up-front.

Recommendation: we can grant an initial 3M-token credit (covers most of week-1 POC + buffer) and then do a follow-up burn-rate check after 10 business days. If ACME is trending >5M / mo, we'll propose a reserved pricing conversation (Dedicated or committed blocks) to get unit cost down.

I've attached a quick export (acme-pilot-usage.csv) that you can populate or we can take a look at your logs. Also attached pilot-pricing-sheet.pdf with per-1M scenarios and expected latency tiers.

If acceptable, Marissa — can you route approval for the 3M token credit? I estimate the cost to Redwood at ~ $6k at our internal blended rate (we'll confirm).

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Request: approve 3M pilot credit for ACME (deal ACME-2026-PILOT-3421)

Hi Vivek —

Quick request for sign-off. ACME (contact: Alex Johnson) ran a discovery call today. They expect ~1.5M tokens in the first week and ~7.5M tokens/month if we scale. Their procurement target is <$2k / 1M tokens for the POC.

Ben proposes a 3M token credit to cover the first phase of the pilot and give us a 10-business-day runway to validate burn rate and quality. Ben's preliminary estimate of Redwood cost for the credit is ~$6k (blended internal).

Why this is recommended:
- Short runway credit reduces friction for ACME to test real traffic and produce telemetry.
- We can instrument their flows and get clear unit-econ data to present a committed offer if they scale.
- ACME is likely to convert to a reserved-capacity conversation given the volumes.

Attachments: pilot-pricing-sheet.pdf (pricing scenarios) and an SOW draft (ACME_SOW_draft.pdf) you can review.

Request: please approve the 3M token credit and a 2-week extension of the pilot credits (if needed) so we can complete the burn-rate check and present a commercial proposal.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Approved.

Please proceed with issuing a 3,000,000 token credit to ACME and set a calendar reminder for a 10-business-day burn-rate review. Finance (Evelyn) — please confirm and book the subsidy as "pilot credits" under ACME-3421.

Marissa — once issued, please update the HubSpot deal and send a short note to Alex outlining the credit, timeline, and next steps (SOW/PO). Include the DocuSign link for the SOW if they want it signed.

Thanks,
Vivek
